why: Sharks, Humans and Blood (pilot, 2026-11-14): more Sharks and Humans for Shabraz's flying and Brallin's trample, and a Blood-token line — a Blood activation discards (Brallin: counter, ping) and draws (Shabraz: counter, life), and Jaws pings again on the sacrifice. Strong and uncompromising: nothing given up unless it buys something bigger.

Card 1 (2026-11-20, pilot approved; doctor + analyst, strategist dissented for Mariner): the branch ran zero no-maximum-hand-size effects beside five draw-sevens; Leng lets each wheel discard go on top instead, so a wheel is seven Shabraz counters while the hand is kept and Brallin still pings per card (stacks 001-003). Knife's Blood token is the discard-to-draw step the pilot called laborious (logs 005-007).

Card 2 (2026-11-20, pilot approved; doctor + analyst; strategist wanted Mask of Memory cut, rejected as draw on the axis): a turn-two Human+Shark body for the raced-from-an-empty-board loss shape (003/004/005/009) that taxes every targeted spell on Shabraz; Fireshrieker was the dearest and only single-job piece of five kill-from-eleven enablers, and stack 006 re-resolves on Lizard Blades. Runner-up cut was Talisman of Creativity.

summary.title: Sharks, Humans and Blood, with the wheels kept in hand and a turn-two body
summary.blurb: Adds Jaws and more Sharks and Humans, a Blood-token line that feeds both commanders, Library of Leng so a wheel grows Shabraz without throwing the hand away, and Unsettled Mariner as an early body that taxes removal on Shabraz; pays with Ceremonial Knife, Fireshrieker, rocks and a re-cut mana base.
